description:
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Time Walk, Coveted Prize, and any number of cards with different mana costs to your hand and putting Seasons Past on the bottom of your library.
Cast Coveted Prize by paying {4}{B}, putting Seasons Past from your library into your hand.
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, granting you an extra turn.
Repeat each turn.
